question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"About" appropriately estimates the approximate number of flowering plants, aligning with "47,000 plant species" mentioned earlier. **
 
• The word **"about"** correctly conveys an approximation and fits the context of providing an estimated figure.
 
• It maintains coherence with the general nature of scientific description, which often uses approximations.
 
• In the context, **"about"** is needed to introduce an approximate figure, ensuring the text remains informative and accurate.
 
• The use of **"about"** helps maintain a flow and continuity in the passage, corresponding with how numbers and quantities are presented.
 
• It correctly modifies the following numeral, providing clarity and precision in the enumeration of plant species.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Of"** would not make sense in this context as it doesn’t indicate approximation.
 
• **"A"** is not appropriate as it implies a singular item, not an approximate number.
 
• **"Many"** indicates a large, unspecified quantity and does not fit well with the context which requires an approximate figure.
